en.blocked: Available after the current task ends
en.helpText: Follow progress, revise tasks, or create a task here. Questions do not interrupt execution. Use /task <objective> to create a task and /compact to compact this conversation.
en.idle: Ask about progress, revise an objective, or describe a new task
en.legacyRequirementResults: This older job has no requirement outcomes; its original evidence level is retained.
en.reviewAwaitApproval: Plan review passed; execution awaits your approval.
en.reviewConnectFailed: Connection failed; retry or enter /task status in the primary conversation.
en.reviewConnectNeeded: Only saved Session records are loaded. Select Connect Session to restore controls; connecting starts neither a review nor task execution.
en.reviewContinuing: The controller continues the primary Agent.
en.reviewEnableNeeded: Supervisor is off. Re-enable it, then choose the review recovery action. Re-enabling does not start task execution.
en.reviewFaultDecision: The decision failed evidence or format validation.
en.reviewFaultEvidence: An evidence read failed; no valid decision was recorded.
en.reviewFaultPaused: Review fault; task paused without acceptance. See the currently available controls.
en.reviewFaultProtocol: The reviewer did not submit a valid decision.
en.reviewFaultRecoveryBoundary: The task is paused with review evidence preserved. A successful retry continues only with a valid earlier approval and no user pause; otherwise it awaits manual recovery.
en.reviewFaultSnapshot: The artifact snapshot could not be prepared.
en.reviewFaultStale: Requirements or artifacts changed; the old review no longer applies.
en.reviewFaultTimeout: The review exceeded its own deadline.
en.reviewFaultUnknown: The review failed with an unconfirmed error source. Inspect the review process for details.
en.reviewFixArtifacts: Inspect workspace changes first; a new review prepares a fresh snapshot. Resubmit the plan if requirements or the plan changed.
en.reviewFixAuth: Check credentials, access permissions or quota in model settings before using the current recovery control.
en.reviewFixInfrastructure: Check workspace access, snapshot storage and the check runner before using the current recovery control.
en.reviewFixInternal: Expand Review process for diagnostics and check plugin and Host versions. Address the fault before using the current recovery control.
en.reviewFixModel: Check the review model configuration and provider plugin before using the current recovery control.
en.reviewFixProvider: Inspect the request error in the review process. Use the current recovery control after rate limits or service faults clear.
en.reviewHistoricalFault: Historical fault; it does not affect the current task.
en.reviewInspectFault: Expand Review process for the error and unfinished work before using the current recovery control.
en.reviewManualRecovery: The review stopped. See task details for the currently available controls.
en.reviewNextNode: Dependent nodes wait for an applicable decision.
en.reviewNextPlan: Pass follows the approval policy; revisions return to planning.
en.reviewOpenPrimary: View the review process in the primary conversation
en.reviewPreviousDecision: Earlier settled review; this is not the current activity outcome
en.reviewPrimaryChecking: The primary Agent awaits the Supervisor check; the task is not complete.
en.reviewPrimaryWaiting: The primary Turn ended; Supervisor is reviewing.
en.reviewRecoveryUnavailable: The review record is missing or bound to another task version, so recovery is unavailable. Inspect diagnostics; to plan again, enter /task edit <full objective> in the primary conversation (clears plan approval), or turn Supervisor off.
en.reviewRestartNeeded: The original job cannot continue. Address the cause below, then select Start a new review. The old record is retained; execution still requires approval or manual resume.
en.reviewResumeNeeded: No review or task execution is running. Select Resume task; an interrupted review resumes first and may still require approval or a separate execution resume.
en.reviewRetryDeadline: The original review expired. Starting a new review preserves that failure and still requires approval or manual execution resume.
en.reviewRetryNeeded: The review stopped without task acceptance. Address the cause below, then select Retry review to continue the original job within its original deadline.
en.reviewRetryNonTransient: This fault is not eligible for automatic retry.
en.reviewRevisionNext: The primary Agent applies review feedback.
en.reviewUnavailable: Review is outside the current record window
en.reviewUserNext: Read the review report, state your decision in the primary conversation, then select Resume task.
en.sessionEvidenceBoundary: A separate Session does not itself establish independent verification
en.unresolved: Answer the open questions in chat
